title: Buffalo Rose/ East Nashville
description:
Buffalo Rose is a light and bright space filled with mid century modern decor that meets rustic Nashville. We are in the heart of East Nashville close to the hottest restaurants, bars and coffee shops in the city. Downtown is a super quick uber ride away. We are located half a mile from Shelby Bottoms and some of our personal favorite hangout spots. We hope you’ll love Buffalo Rose as much as we do. Follow us on Instagram at @urbancowgirlproperties and share your experiences with us!

The space
Buffalo Rose is a quaint and cool space in the heart of East Nashville. We are on a quiet street just a few minutes from some of our favorite restaurants like Cafe Roze, Vinyl Tap Records, Five Points Pizza and Mas Tacos. Biking and jogging are very popular when the weather is nice and we are easily accessible to Shelby Bottoms Greenway. The house is two bedrooms both with queen beds and brand new mattresses. The living room is a great place to gather for drinks or food and watch tv. We have an amazon stick so Netflix, amazon, etc are available for your use. Our kitchen is filled with cooking ware, dinner plates, coffee mugs, glasses, silverware, etc. Enjoy a fresh cup of coffee and feel free to use the fridge and pantry for any of your needs.

Guest access
The whole place is yours. The yard is shared with the other unit. We ask that you be considerate of our neighbors please!

Other things to note
Parking- you should park in front of your unit. Pull all the way up to the string of lights and park. Someone else may be in Unit D and we do not want to block them in.
